finding.title: Unknown directory entry types can publish nonregular entries as regular resource scope
evidence: New DT_UNKNOWN fallback tests (status.st_mode & S_IFREG) rather than the masked file type. Linux platform headers define S_IFMT=0170000, S_IFREG=0100000 and S_IFSOCK=0140000; socket type & S_IFREG is nonzero. S_ISREG instead compares (mode & S_IFMT) == S_IFREG.

For a socket with a valid resource-looking filename, the new branch reaches observe_discovered, retained_count and seen_blobs at947-950, then marks discovery Complete/total_known at953-955. The same socket reported as native DT_SOCK is skipped at936-937. This makes requested known logical scope depend on whether readdir supplies d_type and can publish a nonregular nonpayload entry as selected.

Independent tiny probe linked own separately compiled679 libfossilize/libminiz, with a private readdir wrapper only. It wrote one2-byte regular compute20 entry and created one local AF_UNIX socket named compute21.json. Native-type row satisfies exact expected regular-only discovered/selected union and socket has_entry=false. With identical physical directory and DT_UNKNOWN forced, prepare succeeds but report includes both20/21 and has_entry(socket)=true.
D20/dtype mode=native prepared=1 discovered=1 selected=1 socket_has_entry=0 exact_regular_only=1
D20/dtype mode=unknown prepared=1 discovered=2 selected=2 socket_has_entry=1 exact_regular_only=0

Adjacent source-only proof: the fallback calls ::stat at924, following symlinks. A symlink-to-regular therefore receives S_IFREG and passes even a corrected S_IFMT predicate, while native DT_LNK is skipped at936-937. A dangling link can instead turn otherwise skipped nonresource directory content into failed discovery. No symlink runtime probe was run; these are direct control-flow consequences, separate from the observed socket rows.

c20-u4-dtype-compile exited0. c20-u4-dtype-run exited ordinary1, timed_out=false, with FAIL D20/dtype-only-regular-files. No compiler failure, signal or deadline substitutes for the observed incorrect metadata. Candidate source/tests were not edited.
requested_change: Use a platform-appropriate exact regular-file type predicate (S_ISREG or (st_mode & S_IFMT) == S_IFREG) and classify the directory entry itself without following symlinks in the new DT_UNKNOWN fallback (e.g. lstat on POSIX with suitable platform handling). Preserve native DT_REG-only entry semantics: sockets and symlink entries remain excluded consistently when d_type is unavailable; a regular symlink target must not turn the link into a selected resource.

Extend the existing bounded private directory adapter regression: one regular resource entry, a local Unix socket and local symlinks with resource-looking filenames (one targeting the regular file and one dangling), comparing native d_type and DT_UNKNOWN rows. Assert exact regular-only discovered/selected sets, retained count/completeness and has_entry(nonregular)==false; retain the positive DT_UNKNOWN regular-file/readback control and Release-active checks. The symlink controls ensure a mask-only socket fix does not leave fallback/native classification inconsistent. No large file, network connection or shipping hook is needed.
